fact: The Centre d'innovation technologique de N'Djamena, created by arrete n0050 of 1 September 2025, was officially launched with an aim to incubate Chadian tech startups, with no incubation programme or cohort stated.
The startup day was held at WenakLabs in N'Djamena with Tcharay HUB, both named as hubs with founders speaking; no programme or cohort is stated.
